## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (79%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Simulated frozen section is flagged unreliable (tier 1) and cannot exclude InSitu (16%).

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 79%, InSitu 16%, Normal 5%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Low invasive risk; InSitu possible |
| Conformal set | {Benign, InSitu} (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged), 100% OOD, JPEG deg. 3 [F6] | Suspect out-of-distribution degraded input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top classes disagree) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 (40%) Benign, 3/5 (60%) Normal (79%–83% similarity) [F5] | Mixed Benign and Normal neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.09, contrib -0.62) pushes away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.45, contrib -0.36); unreliable 0/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.19, contrib -0.30) supports benign stroma [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (+1.07, contrib -0.24), caption-inconsistent · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20 AI spot-check).

## Could be wrong if
- Severe JPEG degradation (severity 3, 100% OOD) hides atypia; foundation models disagree and cell segmentation is disabled.
- An in situ lesion (16% probability, inside conformal set) is masked by artifact or lies in deeper levels.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 0, 6**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (33%, 22%, 18% risk) and region 0 nuclear pleomorphism (+0.88).
2. **Region 5**: Check ducts for in situ atypia (+1.10 score); consider drafted deeper levels and recut orders.
3. **Regions 7, 11**: Check lateral (74%) and inferior (49%) margins; simulated frozen-section margin call is defer [F7].
